==Original Dream Journal Entry That Inspired The Episode==
I induced lucidity via sleep paralysis. I flew off into space to star gaze. (This dream takes place in the same continuity of lucid dreams that started on 06/11/2025 and has continued to the present. These dreams take place in the Elven Village that resembles huts of wood and white stone, as well as castles, and is located in a forest of tall pine trees.)
I created a spaceship around myself and leaped into hyperspace. (The Black Cat Space Ship resembles a large metal black jaguar with rocket thrusters instead of a tail. The ship has glowing green eyes and is covered with glowing green circuitry. The entire ship is the size of an eighteen wheeler truck.)
I fell in and out of lucidity, as the dream looped and changed multiple times. (This experience could be best described as a series of false awakenings that would cause me to eventually end up back on The Black Cat Space Ship, but under different circumstances. It felt like being pulled across different universes where events happened differently.)
